name: Bauernhof Schellhorn
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Schellhorn in Schwoich offers a charming holiday home for a relaxing farm vacation in the Tyrolean Unterland. Its peaceful and idyllic rural location near Kufstein invites guests to unwind in a traditional Tyrolean atmosphere. The accommodation is particularly suited for families and travelers who appreciate authentic countryside living. From Schwoich, visitors can embark on picturesque hikes, cycling adventures, and memorable excursions into the surrounding Kaiser Mountains.
